phrases.text: In nineteen thirty-two, the Australian army went to war against birds. And lost.
Twenty thousand emus were eating the farmers' wheat. So soldiers arrived with machine guns and a truck.
The emus split into small groups and ran in every direction.
The truck could not catch them.
The guns could not hit them.
After a month, the army gave up and went home.
The birds were still there. Today the emus are still eating wheat.
The final score was birds one, army zero.
